verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a centralized rule system for defining and enforcing engineering standards (qodo-docs-12, qodo-docs-38). Its Rule Miner generates rules from pull request history (qodo-docs-13), which builds a persistent store of team conventions that is then applied to every PR. It also keeps a complete history of findings and decisions (qodo-docs-15) and lets reviewers dismiss findings (qodo-docs-3). Missing for 10: evidence that dismissals or past review decisions automatically feed back into future reviews, depth on how mined rules are curated and applied, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
